title: Rust + GTK4 + libadwaita as the only UI stack
context: FluentFlyout is a WPF/.NET application. The port must feel native on Fedora/GNOME and must render through GTK's GSK Vulkan renderer, which is verified to be available in the installed GTK 4.22.4.
options: Rust + gtk4-rs + libadwaita-rs (native widgets, GSK renderer)
proposal: Rust + gtk4-rs + libadwaita-rs, using GTK CSS and AdwAnimation for the visual layer.
decision: Rust + gtk4-rs + libadwaita-rs. No webview and no custom Vulkan renderer: GTK's own GSK Vulkan backend satisfies the graphics requirement without reimplementing text shaping, input methods and accessibility.
consequences: GNOME-native widgets, icon theme, accessibility and input methods come for free.
Visual fidelity is expressed with CSS classes instead of XAML styles.
The app cannot reproduce Windows taskbar embedding or global input hooks.
